120th Episode: Why Hirean? (4)
Of course, it could have been a leap. They had only just exchanged a single bout. There was no evidence that he was a Black Knight.
'But the unique sense of crisis that I felt when I faced the Black Knights... it's too similar.'
They would know as they continued to fight. They pushed their swords again.
The darkly dyed blade of Brada Mante penetrated between the two thugs' swords, and Dante took advantage of the gap to strike a blow to their rear.
The thug that Jin felt was a Black Knight blocked both of their attacks simultaneously by drawing a circle with his sword, and the remaining thug turned around to aim for Dante's neck.
Since he was already tired and their original target, they tried to take care of Dante first.
"Ugh!"
Dante stepped back with his footwork, scattering the sword energy. Despite seemingly significant bleeding, his shining aura was fierce.
Although they hadn't fought together very often, as always, Jin and Dante read each other's swords flexibly, like people who had been in sync for a long time.
It was natural for the tide to turn, and the thugs had to admit that their plan was going awry.
Clang-!
Jin brushed aside the thugs' swords and took his place next to Dante.
Looking down, he saw that Dante's hand, gripping the sword, was trembling.
It wasn't out of fear.
It was out of anger. The countless fallen bodies around them were either people Dante had tried to save or people who had tried to save Dante.
-Dante!
-Yes, Grandfather!
-The knights cannot all be gathered. They are already outside as well.
-Outside too...!
-As a knight who will become the lord of Geomhwang Castle, take responsibility and evacuate the general guests.
When the situation began, Ron gave Dante such an order.
However, Dante believed that he had not only failed to carry out that order, but also drove more people to death.
Seeing his feelings so clearly, Jin was not in a good mood either.
"Dante, you need to get your act together."
There was no time to console him now. It wasn't a problem that could be improved with consolation.
"…I know. Thanks to you, I'm getting a little clearer."
The trembling of the hand holding the sword stopped.
Dante's dark eyes, which did not suit him, stared at the thugs.
However, it was hard to believe that such dark eyes could emit such a brilliant aura that dyed Dante's sword.
'Buy me some time.'
Even without speaking aloud, Jin could understand Dante's intention.
The Emperor's Sword.
Hirean's Crimson Transmission Sword Technique. It was about to unfold.
The thugs who recognized the sword began to thrust their swords again. Jin blocked their swords so that Dante could safely draw his aura.
One of them wasn't a problem, but the Black Knight-level thug's sword was fierce.
Each strike contained power that matched the martial arts of a high-ranking warrior.
Even a seemingly casually swung ordinary sword contained the weight of a mountain.
A perfectly refined swordsmanship without a speck of impurity, like pure gold.
There weren't many who could wield such a sword. Black Knight, the name crossed Jin's mind once again.
Flick!
The thug's sword grazed Jin's nose. It was a strike launched while the Black Knight-level thug's stance was broken, and had Jin not reacted, his neck would have been sliced.
Three sword blades were chaotically emitting sparks. The heat from the sword energy caused sweat and blood droplets to evaporate instantly.
'It's tight, damn it.'
At first glance, the battle seemed to be evenly matched.
However, that was only because the Black Knight-level thug had not yet used his full strength.
He had been conserving his strength since Jin's appearance, but it was unclear whether this was due to caution or another reason.
In the meantime, they needed to reduce their numbers.
'I don't know why he's not using his full strength, but I have to kill the weaker one now.'
Whooosh...!
Dark energy gathered around Jin. In an instant, screens of energy like webs were created, and Jin moved between them, firing black sword energy.
He didn't forget to protect Dante in the process.
About ten seconds, the time needed for Dante to fully unleash the Emperor's Sword.
If his physical condition had been fine, he wouldn't have taken so long, but there was no choice due to severe bleeding.
Considering Dante's chronic issue with 'stamina', it was quite remarkable that he could use the secret technique.
Swoosh-!
The black sword energy shot from within the curtain severed the thug's arm.
It was the arm holding the sword. As the thug flinched and tried to pick up the sword, Brada Mante charged at his neck.
Clang!
The Black Knight-level thug deflected Brada Mante.
'Annoying...!'
But at that moment.
Dante's secret technique was completed. Much faster than Jin and the thugs had anticipated, Dante's sword was already aimed at them.
Like the flash of a flash bomb, a brilliant light filled the grand hall.
Then came the sound. The unique sharp noise of a blade cutting through the air was amplified, ringing to the point of making ears ring.
"Did you underestimate Hirean...?!"
A sword spirit emerged from the radiance.
It wasn't just one sword. Bright white sword spirits poured out from every corner of the dazzling light that filled the great hall.
Emperor's Sword Secret Technique
Sun
The name of the sword technique Dante unfolded.
As its name suggests, the radiant aura that filled the great hall looked like the sun. The aura was so bright that it even obscured the curtain of spirit energy Jin had created.
There were hundreds of swords.
Although the black knight-class monster managed to block Jin's sword, it couldn't block all of the sun's swords.
One sword pierced the back of the monster whose arm had been cut off. The creature tried to shudder and dodge, but there was no way to avoid the sword spirits flying from all directions.
Before it could even let out a scream, new swords pierced its abdomen, chest, neck, and head.
The creature soon disappeared without a trace in the sun. The fallen flesh, bones, and blood turned to ash in the heat of the aura.
'Dante has become stronger.'
Hyiran was also the world's second-ranked swordsman, shoulder to shoulder with Runcandel, and Dante was his successor. It was only fitting that he possessed such power.
Now, only one black knight-class monster remained.
The sun's swords continued to assault him.
However, unlike the previously killed monster, he displayed incredible strength by deflecting every single one of the hundreds of swords without missing a beat.
His robe was torn, but for a few more seconds, Dante's sword couldn't directly cut him.
'Since he forced it out in an exhausted state, the secret technique won't be able to show its full power.'
Jin's thoughts were correct.
Even if their opponent was a Runcandel black knight-class monster, it was impossible not to suffer any injuries from Dante's secret technique.
Dante revealed himself from within the radiance.
Frustration rose at the fact that he couldn't do anything to the monster even after unleashing the Sun secret technique, but his eyes remained cold and clear.
Huu, huu...!
Jin felt Dante's breath beside him, rougher than when he first arrived. Jin sensed that Dante had reached his limit.
The black knight-class monster felt the same. He clearly understood that for Dante, continuing to fight was close to a miracle.
"If you use more power there, you could die. Hyiran's next master."
For the first time, the black knight-class monster spoke.
His voice was distorted and muffled. However, even if it was his real voice, Jin couldn't recognize the black knight, as there were only a few he could identify.
'As expected, he's not trying to kill Dante.'
If the goal was simply the destruction of Hyiran, killing Dante would have been the best option.

However, there had already been countless opportunities to kill Dante. The reason the black knight-class monster, with his overwhelming skill, continued to fight Dante was because the battle was meant to capture him alive.
"It's not for the ones who know no honor to worry about my life."
At this, the black knight-class monster lowered his head.
"Even just standing seems burdensome, and if the backlash starts, you'll have to live the rest of your life crippled. Are you okay with that?"
The monster's words were true.
Under normal circumstances, Hailan's best healers would have been able to treat Dante immediately, but not in this situation.
Becoming crippled, losing aura, or death. Those were the only three possibilities Dante would face if the backlash began.
'And in that case, his value as a hostage would drastically decrease. That's the last thing the monster would want.'
The monster's goal was to kidnap Dante. With Kinzel, they would later use Dante for negotiations with Hailan or other families.
If Dante was not in good condition at that time, there would inevitably be a problem.
However, of course, Dante showed no signs of backing down.
Dante Hailan would never retreat or make a humiliating choice in any situation.
It was impossible to imagine Dante begging for his life or compromising his beliefs for a more efficient choice.
'As admirable and likable as you are, my friend.'
He couldn't stand by and watch his friend become crippled or die.
"You said it's not your concern...!"
Thwack!
Jin slapped Dante's throat with the back of his hand.
"Cough, choke!"
Dante coughed up a mouthful of blood and hunched over, unable to confront or be angry with Jin.
He had struck Dante's throat with just enough force that he could have died.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have been able to stop his stubborn friend.
'Somehow, it seems like I often have to knock out people like Beradin and Dante like this.'
Dante, who had fallen, twitched and stopped moving.
Jin immediately checked his pulse and the backlash reaction, and fortunately, Dante seemed to have lost consciousness.
"Phew."
He breathed a sigh of relief. Just now, the blow could have inadvertently triggered the backlash.
For Jin, it was a huge gamble.
The sun's aura that filled the battlefield momentarily subsided.
For a moment, silence hung between Jin and the black knight-class monster.
"No matter how much I think about it, you seem to be a black knight of Runecandle."
With a swish, Jin aimed his Bradamante at the monster.

"If you're a black knight, I recommend you just back off. Bringing down Hailan and becoming enemies with the heir of your affiliated family seems like a rather unprofitable business, don't you think?"
Whooosh... Crack!
Bradamante was imbued with aura, revealing the blue flames of Tes.
